text: {"lessons":["I’ll avoid selling after a loss just because the position is down; I’ll first check whether the investment case has changed and whether the trade improves the portfolio.","I’ll avoid repeatedly reversing positions without a clear reason: buying and then soon selling Stock D at a loss is a reminder to set a thesis and time horizon before trading.","I’ll size purchases and keep cash deliberately, checking that each trade has a stronger rationale than holding my current positions; these account results alone don’t show whether I beat the market."]}
